algorithm.random: stdlib random.Random/choices; canonical analyzer order preserved
algorithm.quantile: Sorted floor index int(p*(N-1)), p=.025/.975, no interpolation
algorithm.metric_units: Ratio changes and CI endpoints are fractions, not percent; multiply100 for percentages
algorithm.independence: One paired seed/game, no repeats; four-game regime additionally resamples paired four-seed clusters and8 paired actual wave spans. Caps consume wave windows and count0 wins.
algorithm.limits: No universal optimum, population/causal worker-count or production acceptance. Different regimes also change affinity/concurrency.

evidence_limits: Original absolute command/cwd/environment strings are compared as provenance only; none is opened or executed. Input resolution uses relative bundle layout only.
Binaries, engine runtime dependencies and original fixture trees are not required or executed. Their reported hashes/declared identities are checked, not their absent bytes.
Optional checksum sidecar bodies may be omitted; missing bodies are explicit. Endpoint metadata is not full per-tick simulation proof.

This recomputes canonical Python RNG/floor-quantile estimators, not independent V8/root PRNG/linear-quantile sensitivity runs. CPython/version recorded; compare retained numbers within rounding tolerance.
